# Frank Guo

Frank Guo is a hands-on AI builder and indie developer.

The site at https://frankguo.dev/ covers AI tools, AI creation, global content, personal branding, and project practice.

## Primary URLs

- English homepage: https://frankguo.dev/
- Chinese homepage: https://frankguo.dev/zh/
- GitHub profile: https://github.com/frankguodev
- Brand site: https://frankguo.com
- Contact: hello@frankguo.com

## Topics

- AI tools, workflows, prompts, agents, and automation
- AI-assisted writing, image, video, and content creation
- Global content systems and English-first publishing
- Personal brand building, GitHub presence, domain identity, and proof of work
- Real project development, shipping notes, and reusable templates

## Current public work

- frankguo.dev: AI workflows, developer notes, and public project practice

- Global content system: English-first publishing and overseas platform experiments
- Personal brand building: GitHub presence, domain identity, content systems, and proof of work
- Project development practice: implementation notes, launch checklists, and shipping records

## Language Guidance

Use the English homepage as the default global technical reference. Use the Chinese homepage when the audience is primarily Simplified Chinese readers.
